environment: Node test runner, python3, cli-runner with scratch git repos, skill copy from the S-020 branch worktree

cases.title: branches.py name --kind verify and rt.I.branchName give the same branch for three formats
cases.given: A scratch git repo and the formats sdlc/{name}, feature/PROJ-1-{name} and feature/PROJ-1-{name:lower}.
cases.when: Run branches.py name --kind verify for 4 ids, 3 rounds, 5 profiles (including Http-API and http-api) and 2 parts. Compare with branchName on the tail <id>-v<round>-<profile>-<part>.
cases.then: Every pair is equal, every exit code is 0, and the scratch tree does not change.
cases.expected: 360 equal pairs, exit 0, no tree change
cases.actual: 360 equal pairs, exit 0, no tree change

evidence.title: sample pairs
evidence.inline:
sdlc/{name} | S-001-v0-http-api-0 | exit=0 | py=sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api-0 | js=sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api-0
feature/PROJ-1-{name} | S-001-v0-Http-API-0 | exit=0 | py=feature/PROJ-1-S-001-v0-Http-API-0 | js=feature/PROJ-1-S-001-v0-Http-API-0

cases.title: branches.py reads the format from .sdlc/config.json and matches the loop script
cases.given: A repo whose config holds branchFormat feature/PROJ-1-{name:lower}.
cases.when: Run branches.py name --kind verify --id S-020 --round 0 --profile http-api --part 0 with no --format.
cases.then: The branch is feature/PROJ-1-s-020-v0-http-api-0, equal to branchName.

cases.title: An empty branchFormat falls back to sdlc/{name} and matches branches.py
cases.given: The loop script with branchFormat empty; a repo with no config.
cases.when: Run branches.py name for S-020 round 1 profile cli part 0.
